title: Cisco Webex Event
description: Represents an activity event within a Webex organization, used for compliance and auditing purposes.

resource.description: The resource type affected by the event.

type.description: The type of event that occurred.

appId.description: The application ID that triggered the event.

actorId.description: The person ID who performed the action.

orgId.description: The organization ID where the event occurred.

created.description: Date and time the event occurred.

data.description: The resource data at the time of the event.
